title: In JetBrains Ktor before 3.6.1 missing Domain attribute validation in client cookie storage allowed cookie injection…
description: JetBrains Ktor versions before 3.6.1 have a vulnerability due to missing validation of the Domain attribute in client cookie storage, which allows cookie injection. This flaw could enable an attacker to inject cookies improperly. The vulnerability has a low severity score and does not impact confidentiality or availability, only integrity to a limited extent.
